title: A History of Violence
description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner.

title: Flashpoint
description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963.

title: Bring Her Back
description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
description: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home.

title: Time Bandits
description: Cosmic dwarfs take a boy on an odyssey featuring Robin Hood (John Cleese), Napoleon, King Agamemnon (Sean Connery).

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: Smoking Tigers
description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

title: The Art of Getting By
description: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

title: Risky Business
description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

title: Opus
description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

title: Rain Man
description: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: It's Complicated
description: A restaurateur (Meryl Streep) falls into an affair with her remarried ex-husband (Alec Baldwin), while an architect (Steve Martin) that she hired to refurbish her kitchen falls in love with her.

title: The Craft
description: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: Men
description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

title: Walkabout
description: A lost teenager (Jenny Agutter) and her little brother (Lucien John) meet an Aboriginal teen (David Gulpilil) in the Outback.

title: Epic
description: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.

title: A Thousand Words
description: A fast-talking literary agent (Eddie Murphy) must learn how to live without speech upon discovering that he has only a thousand words left to say before he dies.

title: Life of Pi
description: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

title: Arctic
description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

title: King's Ransom
description: An obnoxious businessman (Anthony Anderson) arranges his own kidnapping to foil his wife's (Kellita Smith) impending divorce settlement.

title: Mojave
description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
description: A doctor (Tom Cruise) explores his relationship with his wife (Nicole Kidman) by delving into a sensual underworld.

title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
description: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all.

title: Beirut
description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who returns to service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death.

title: Miss Sloane
description: A cutthroat Washington, D.C., lobbyist (Jessica Chastain) makes powerful new enemies by supporting a bill that imposes regulations on the sale of firearms.

title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
description: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.

title: Road House
description: Hired to tame a rowdy Missouri bar, a Ph.D. bouncer (Patrick Swayze) romances a doctor (Kelly Lynch) and tames the whole town.

title: Robin Hood
description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

title: Wonka
description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

title: Lady Bird
description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school.

title: My Blind Brother
description: An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate).

title: Cocktail
description: The hottest bartender (Tom Cruise) in Manhattan leaves his partner (Bryan Brown), goes to Jamaica and falls for a nice girl (Elisabeth Shue).

title: Papillon
description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape.

title: Black Adam
description: Bestowed with the almighty powers of the gods, Black Adam's unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone.

title: Shazam!
description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

title: The Flash
description: Worlds collide when the Flash travels back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation.

title: Ruby Sparks
description: A struggling novelist (Paul Dano) creates an inspirational female character, who somehow leaps from the page into his home as a real flesh-and-blood woman (Zoe Kazan).

title: Sound of My Voice
description: Two documentary filmmakers (Christopher Denham, Nicole Vicius) set out to expose a cult, but they fall under the control of its charismatic leader (Brit Marling) instead.

title: Shot Caller
description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

title: Fantastic Planet
description: The 39-foot-tall pastel Draags keep leashes on the Oms, their tiny pets descended from humans.

title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
description: A depressed teenager (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a psychiatric facility and winds up in the adult ward, where a fellow patient (Zach Galifianakis) takes him under his wing.

title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
description: Placed under federal protection in Madea's Southern home, a Wall Street banker and his dysfunctional family get a taste of the no-nonsense matriarch's special brand of tough love.

title: Mississippi Masala
description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town.
